name: OutletLinc Dimmer
description: The OutletLinc dimmer, which runs the KeypadLinc code base with load sense and an over-temperature limit.

operatingFlags.name: programmingLock
operatingFlags.description: Linking and programming from the device itself are locked out.

operatingFlags.name: ledOnTransmit
operatingFlags.description: The status LED blinks when the device sends an Insteon message.

operatingFlags.name: resumeDim
operatingFlags.description: Turning the load on at the device restores its last level instead of the on-level.

operatingFlags.name: loadSense
operatingFlags.description: Load sense is on: the device turns its load on when it senses the attached lamp or appliance being switched on.

operatingFlags.name: ledOff
operatingFlags.description: The status LEDs and button backlights are off.

operatingFlags.name: keyBeep
operatingFlags.description: The device beeps when a button is pressed.

operatingFlags.name: radioOff
operatingFlags.description: The device doesn't originate RF messages. It still repeats the RF messages it hears.

operatingFlags.name: powerLineOff
operatingFlags.description: Insteon communication over the power line is off. The device turns it back on whenever it powers up.

operatingFlags.name: applicationRetries
operatingFlags.description: The device retries application messages as many times as its link database says, and reports cleanup errors.

operatingFlags.name: x10Off
operatingFlags.description: X10 sending and receiving are off.

operatingFlags.name: errorBlink
operatingFlags.description: The status LED blinks when a communication error occurs.

operatingFlags.name: cleanupReport
operatingFlags.description: The device sends a success report after the cleanup messages that follow a group command.

operatingFlags.name: checksumRequired
operatingFlags.description: Extended Set and link database write messages must carry a checksum in D14.

readings.name: databaseDelta
readings.description: A count that goes up whenever the link database changes.

readings.name: crcErrorCount
readings.description: The number of messages received with a CRC error.

flagCommands.name: smartHopsOn
flagCommands.description: Starts each message with the hop count of the last acknowledgment received (smart hops).

flagCommands.name: smartHopsOff
flagCommands.description: Starts each message with one hop.

values.name: x10HouseCode
values.description: The X10 house code, or 0x20 for no X10 address.

values.name: rampRate
values.description: The ramp rate, from 0x01 (8 minutes) to 0x1F (0.1 second). 0x00 is 2 seconds.

values.name: onLevel
values.description: The level the load turns on to, from 0x00 (off) to 0xFF (full).

values.name: ledBrightness
values.description: The brightness of the status LEDs, from 0x11 (dimmest) to 0x7F (brightest).

values.name: overTemperatureLimit
values.description: The over-temperature limit. 0x00 and 0xFF turn the limit off, 0x50 is 70 degrees and the default is 0x7D.

writes.name: ledBrightness
writes.description: Sets the brightness of the status LED.

notes: Insteon's earliest command sheet swaps 0x08 and 0x09 (backlight on and off); the later sheets, used here, agree with the Insteon for Hub app.
Insteon's 2009 Developer's Guide reads bit 4 of the 0x00 reply as LED on, but the later command sheets read it as LED off, the state 0x08 sets.
Insteon's 2009 Developer's Guide gives query 0x02 as a signal-to-noise value; the later command sheets count messages with CRC errors there.
Insteon's earlier command sheets give ramp rates 0x00 through 0x1F as 9 minutes down to 0.1 second; the later ones make 0x01 8 minutes and 0x00 2 seconds.
